ABOUT MEGALLERY

About Me

I'm Dan Ashley R. Ginete. Mountain biking is where my curiosity and my adrenaline meet: steep trails, loose dirt, big views and the satisfaction of earning every descent.

I love bikes as much as riding them, from setup and maintenance to how every component works. That same hands-on drive shapes my interest in cars and engines, and I'm always learning a new skill.
